about_the_game:
The Story Rundown 

For years, the food conglomerate Spudnik Biosystems has been tinkering with the perfect GMO formula to get the most nutritional value out of food as possible. After creating the miracle element, "Cholesterite", the town of Tatered Hill becomes infested with all your favorite foods - now demented, ruthless, and human-hungry. 

After being exposed yourself, the player characters - various chefs from the local food court mall - discover odd changes to their bodies. Work with others camped out in the post-apocalyptic mall alone or Co-Op with up to 4 people to quell the infestation and escape the mall.

Main Features 

Food-based enemies

  • Nasty, uncanny, and disgusting designs

  • Unique AI behaviors to fight against

  • Boss enemies

Procedurally generated dungeons

  • Variety of different rooms, layouts, puzzles and environments

  • American, Mexican, Asian, Dessert, and Health food dungeons

Procedurally generated weapons

  • Over 10,000 different weapon combinations

  • 10 food-based ammo types with different combat and environmental effects

  • Scopes, stocks, clips, barrels, and more

Loot

  • Tons of different kinds of loot to collect

  • Stat system to level up different player statistics (speed, damage, accuracy, etc.)

Roguelite 

  • Dying is dangerous, and will cause you to drop loot, weapons, and clear stats

  • Story progression, secrets, and permanent task upgrades are saved throughout runs

Co-Op

  • Up to 4 players online

short_description: Battle the Food-Pocalypse! This roguelike boomer shooter drops you into Tatered Hills Mall, where monstrous, flesh-eating food dishes attack relentlessly. Fight to escape solo or team up in co-op, and brace yourself for wild culinary carnage and a non-stop feast of puns!
